source: Calibrated to the Frost 2013 5 mg BID day-7 AUCtau on 2026-09-09, with CL held at the label 3.3 L/h. Oral data identify only CL/F; this value exceeds the label ~0.50 and the gap is an unresolved conflict between the label IV clearance and the observed oral exposure.
